case_verdicts.GALLAUDET_1980S: SINGLE_STATIONARY_PYRAMID_DIRECT_ECHO_FAIL; multipath/path-switching/distributed stationary scattering remains testable but unverified; raw sonar required.
case_verdicts.SOVIET_QUACKERS: AMBIGUOUS; ASW sonobuoy/SOSUS interpretation has memoir support; pyramid model not admitted.

central_reverse_rule: Y(f)=X(f)H_path(f)H_target(f)+N(f); remove/marginalize X and H_path, then test whether residual H_target refocuses to one Earth-fixed locus across independent passes.
critical_motion_rule: Constant resonant delay creates range bias, not sustained apparent target velocity. A moving apparent focus without target motion requires time-varying path/scattering locus, track association switching or a distributed structure.
